generic_name: Echinacea, Baptisia Tinctoria, Hydrastis Canadensis, Myrrha, Phytolacca Decandra, Trigonella Foenum-Graecum, Zone 5 Tree, Zone 5 Weed, Zone 5 Grass (Herbal Combination Blend)
drug_class: Herbal / Botanical Supplement — Immunomodulatory and Anti-inflammatory
purpose: This is a combination herbal supplement made from several plants traditionally believed to support your immune system and help your body fight off infections. It has been used to help reduce the severity or duration of colds, flu, and upper respiratory infections. Some ingredients may also support healthy digestion and reduce inflammation in the body.
how_it_works: Each plant in this blend works in its own way to help your body. Echinacea and Baptisia help stimulate your immune cells to be more active and ready to fight germs. Goldenseal (Hydrastis), Myrrh, and Phytolacca have natural antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, meaning they may help fight bacteria and reduce swelling and irritation. The other plant ingredients like Fenugreek may help soothe mucous membranes and support overall wellness. Together, they are meant to give your immune system a natural boost.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this blend well, but some may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, or diarrhea. Allergic reactions such as rash, itching, or swelling can occur, especially if you are allergic to plants in the daisy family (like ragweed, chrysanthemums, or marigolds). Some people may notice a bitter taste or mild heartburn.
warnings: Do not use this product if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without first talking to your doctor, as some of these herbs (especially Goldenseal and Phytolacca) can be harmful during pregnancy. People with autoimmune diseases such as lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, or multiple sclerosis should avoid this product, as stimulating the immune system could make their condition worse. Do not take this supplement if you are allergic to any of its plant ingredients. Talk to your pharmacist or doctor before using this if you take any prescription medications, as herbal products can sometimes interact with other drugs. The ingredients labeled 'Zone 5 Tree,' 'Zone 5 Weed,' and 'Zone 5 Grass' are not standard medical ingredients and may refer to unspecified regional plant sources — ask your healthcare provider or pharmacist to clarify exactly what these are before using this product.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies depending on the specific product and brand. Generally, adult doses for immune support blends like this are taken 2 to 3 times per day with water, often at the first sign of a cold or illness. Most products are not meant to be taken continuously for more than 2 to 4 weeks at a time. Always follow the instructions on the product label, and ask your pharmacist if you are unsure how to take it.
